from PIL import Image
import numpy as np, math
for f in ['obs_0103','obs_0104']:
    im=np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/%s.png'%f).convert('RGB')).astype(int)
    R,G,B=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
    fl=(abs(R-G)<25)&(R>120)&(R<190)&(G>110)&(B>90)&(B<165)&(R-B>15)
    print('===',f,'floor px',fl.sum())
    for u in range(0,512,48):
        c=np.nonzero(fl[:,u])[0]
        print('  u%3d'%u, 'none' if not len(c) else 'top v=%d bot v=%d'%(c.min(),c.max()))
" 2>/dev/null
